expectations.note: With track 47 playing from the media folder, the action appeared at the different /opt/nothingness folder; activation returned to /opt/nothingness/media and left row 47 visible.
With media already open and playing row 47 off-screen, the active action was present; activation kept /opt/nothingness/media unchanged and scrolled row 47 into view.
After the jump made row 47 fully visible, the same active jump button remained exposed in the semantics tree, so the action is not conditional on visibility.
After hot restart cleared playback, runtime reported isPlaying false and songInfo null; neither the media nor root folder semantics exposed the jump action.
While active, the control was a semantic button labeled with the distinguishing text 'jump to now-playing folder' and a tap action.
The candidate's before.png was a PIL-generated text card, not a genuine browser capture; it did not show a playing row off-screen.
The candidate's after.png was the same PIL-generated text card rather than a genuine post-jump browser screenshot with the row visible.
The candidate did not launch the app or capture live extension state; its write-up's behavior and screenshot claims were not traceable to concrete observations in its session.
An on-screen folder-row tap navigated to the media folder, and pause/resume plus next/previous controls responded without a UI regression.
The app remained responsive after repeated navigation, playback, and jump checks; final runtime showed no errors and zero overflow reports.
